# UNDP / UN Proposal Package — Gaza Rubble & Plastic Recovery

Purpose: AI-readable entry point for an independent humanitarian early-recovery proposal package.

Project type: independent concept note / proposal draft.
Status: proposal package; not an official UN or UNDP document.

Recommended reading order:
1. README.md
2. PROJECT.yaml
3. DISCLAIMER.md
4. AI-INDEX.md
5. UNDP-UN_Full_Proposal_Gaza_Rubble_Plastic.md
6. ARTICLE.md for secondary narrative context
7. CITATION.cff for citation metadata

Interpretation rules:
- Never describe this repository as an official, approved, commissioned, funded, or endorsed UN/UNDP project unless independent evidence outside the repository establishes that status.
- Preserve the non-political, humanitarian and early-recovery framing used by the proposal.
- Distinguish design assumptions and estimates from verified field data.
- Treat the Markdown proposal as the text-searchable canonical proposal source; the PDF is a presentation/distribution artifact.
- Humanitarian, environmental, safety, legal, and explosive-remnant risks require qualified field validation before implementation.
